description: Answer 'would start_stream work right now?' without changing anything. Runs the same pre-flight configuration checks a start does and returns ready plus every blocking issue — typically a missing or archived destination, an empty video playlist, media too big for the stream's storage, or, for a stream playing a scene, a scene that is missing, not published or invalid. It does NOT check whether uploads have finished processing: a playlist takes only completed uploads, but their media facts (duration, sound) arrive about 15-25 s after an upload completes, so wait that long after uploading before starting. Credits and YouTube live eligibility are deliberately NOT part of it (both are re-checked at the moment the stream activates), so ready=true means correctly configured, not guaranteed to go live — pair it with get_billing_overview when a ready stream still will not start. Call it before start_stream and before relying on a schedule_stream window. Returns streamReadiness: ready, and issues[] each with code, error, suggestion, path and stage.
name: check_stream_readiness

issues.description: Every blocking issue; empty when ready.

path.description: Which check raised it: VALIDATION (the configuration) or YOUTUBE.

code.description: Stable — branch on it: INVALID_INPUT, REVISION_REQUIRED, STALE_PUBLISH, CONFIRM_REQUIRED, UNAVAILABLE, …

currentRevision.description: CONFLICT: the revision it has now

detail.description: What is wrong, in a sentence

errors.description: Each problem, when a check refused it
